recording_defaults.notes: Keep untouched originals; annotations are stored separately.

scenarios.instruction: Hold every object still in a clearly separated starting layout.
Move each object through left, center, and right, pausing in each zone.
Move the toy car behind the box, pause, then reveal it on the other side.
Remove one object completely, wait, then return it in a new zone.
Swap the red, blue, and yellow cups without removing them from view.
Cover the ball with each cup in turn and reveal it between trials.
Move objects while hands and other objects partially block the camera.
Move an object quickly across all zones to stress latest-frame replay.
Repeat a short static and movement sequence under changed lighting or angle.
Combine moves, swaps, containment, disappearance, and reappearance.
